newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1997 producer prices seen up 2.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1997 producer prices seen up 2.0 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's producer price index (PPI) is forecast to rise by 2.0 percent in 1997 versus an estimated 2.5 percent gain in 1996, the Ministry of Finance said on Friday in its 1996/97 economic report.
In 1995, the PPI rose by 4.0 percent.
During the first eight months of 1996, the PPI for the domestic economy rose 1.5 percent versus 4.4 percent in the corresponding 1995 period, the ministry said in its annual report on the economy.
The slower growth is mainly attributable to a fall in prices of agricultural products, particularly rubber and palm oil, it said.
